common_lability_diagnostic.decision: No module pair is consistently positive across branch-length-aware and branch-length-free layers. The simple H3 one-shared-whole-capitulum-lability alternative is not supported by the current three-module data.
common_lability_diagnostic.boundary: This requires module-specific historical structure but does not itself prove developmental or genetic modular evolvability.

claim_boundary: Source-backed, topology-conditioned repeated-state lower bounds and module-overlap diagnostics only. Repeated steps are not adaptive-convergence counts; exact transition placement is not equally identifiable across modules.
